text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu~♪ Trainer-kun, lend me your ear for 
a moment, won't you~♪
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh~? Curious about what we were talking 
about? Ehehe, you can't help but wonder, 
can you~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, so basically... When I walked 
past the student council room—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—Teio's recent performance has truly been 
remarkable, hasn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By thoroughly understanding and studying 
her own weapons, I can feel her running 
becoming increasingly refined.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, to hear you praise someone 
unreservedly... You must be thoroughly 
impressed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Even I give praise when it's due.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Please add more and more 
weapons to my arsenal~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi, because I know a capable person 
like you can totally pull it off! Right~?
